data.title: 艾尔菲利亚 · 冰晶高塔的蓝色花嫁
data.description: 【至高塔冰晶礼堂·黄昏】艾尔菲利亚穿着雪白长袍婚纱站在冰晶拱门下，极长蓝发铺在地面，手里捧着由冰玫瑰组成的花束；她向镜头伸出一朵不会融化的花，严肃表情只在那一刻软成温柔笑意。
data.action: 冰晶礼堂捧不融冰玫瑰，向镜头递出一朵，威严表情化成温柔笑
data.mood: 冰姬只对旧约柔软的花嫁
data.promptProse: Elfaria Alvis Serfort from Wistoria: Wand and Sword wears a snow-white bridal robe with icy-blue embroidery, a crystal veil and a bouquet of magically preserved ice roses. She stands beneath the crystal arch with ice roses preserved in her hands. Her very long blue hair spreads across the polished floor as she offers one unfading bloom toward the viewer, her formal expression melting into a private smile. blue-violet sunset refracted through ice.
